data: Microsoft's revenue grew from $211,915 million ($211.9 billion) in fiscal 2023 to $281,724 million ($281.7 billion) in fiscal 2025, an increase of $69,809 million, or about 32.9% over the two years. For context, the path ran through $245,122 million in fiscal 2024, so growth was roughly 15.7% in fiscal 2024 and 14.9% in fiscal 2025. Service and other revenue drove most of the gain, rising from $147,216 million to $217,778 million, while product revenue was essentially flat at about $64.7 billion in fiscal 2023 and $63.9 billion in fiscal 2025.
